scope: 503 logic checks; 19 real Chromium/IndexedDB per-book persistence checks including restart, independent defaults, failure and delayed-write isolation; 36 existing Chromium reading-mode/card/gesture regressions. Legacy slide fixtures now explicitly configure the book mode; settings assertions select main by ID. Affected groups were rerun after fixture corrections, with initial logs retained. Native code only changes the versioned asset URL; SDK build and original signing verified separately.

limits.pdfTopBlurProfile: Shared web/assets/reader-edge.json; same bounded reader-edge-height as EPUB
limits.pdfFirstPageLeadingStrip: Button bottom, fixed in document coordinates

limitations: Native PdfRenderer/RenderNode/WebView transparent composition and MediaStore were not run on a physical Android device; browser native calls were mocked.

Per-book mode controls apply to the existing EPUB/TXT reading engine. Native PDF remains continuous scroll; no PDF paging engine was added. Actual Android touch, FPS and persistence after process death require device verification.
PDF navigation uses a bounded page list and bookmarks; embedded PDF outline parsing, OCR and text translation are not implemented.
